title: Compliance Manual — Restart Clock for Payment Arrangements and the Resumption of Outbound Contact
content:
When a plan under Payment Arrangements resumes after a hold, the restart clock offset follows outbound contact after the hold: the restart clock starts on a date fixed by the hold, and the offset is the number of days from the handling date to that date.

## Clause

The hold is the one on the plan's account whose decision date is the plan's suspended date. Its ended date, and its tier's terms — whether the tier pauses outbound calls and the tier's contact-resume delay in days — are read from Hardship and Protective Holds.

(a) When the hold's tier paused outbound calls and contact may not yet resume, that is when the hold's ended date plus the tier's contact-resume delay days is still after the handling date, the clock starts on the date contact may resume and the offset is the days from the handling date to that date.

(b) When the hold's tier did not pause outbound calls and the hold ended no more than 7 days before the handling date, the clock starts on the day after the hold's ended date and the offset is the days from the handling date to that day, which may be negative.

(c) Otherwise the clock starts on the handling date and the offset is zero.

The date contact may resume is the hold's ended date advanced by the tier's contact-resume delay in calendar days.

## Input — judgement — output

| Tier pauses outbound calls | Timing | Clock starts on | Offset |
|---|---|---|---|
| Yes | Ended date plus the delay is after the handling date | The date contact may resume | Days from the handling date to that date (positive) |
| Yes | Ended date plus the delay is on or before the handling date | The handling date | 0 |
| No | Hold ended 7 days or fewer before the handling date | The day after the ended date | Days from the handling date to that day (zero or negative) |
| No | Hold ended more than 7 days before the handling date | The handling date | 0 |

## Hypothetical cases (handling date 20 June)

- Tier pauses calls, delay 10 days, hold ended 14 June: contact may resume on 24 June, after 20 June — the clock starts on 24 June, offset 4.
- Same tier, hold ended 5 June: 15 June is not after 20 June — offset 0.
- Tier does not pause calls, hold ended 17 June (3 days before): the clock starts on 18 June, offset minus 2.
- Tier does not pause calls, hold ended 19 June: the clock starts on 20 June, offset 0.
- Tier does not pause calls, hold ended 12 June (8 days before): offset 0.
